auditory_note: Tap ▶ Listen to play each clip.

intro.en: Hi Evan! Today we add three more foods: fish, vegetables, and soup. Your older words (numbers, colors, names, ages, pets, and family) come back in new sentences and little chats, so each one gets stronger. Say every line out loud.
intro.py: Nǐ hǎo, Evan! Jīntiān wǒmen zài xué sān zhǒng shíwù: yú, cài hé tāng. Nǐ yǐqián xué de cí (shùzì, yánsè, míngzi, niánlíng, chǒngwù hé jiārén) huì chūxiàn zài xīn de jùzi hé duǎn duìhuà lǐ, ràng měi gè cí gèng jiāngù. Měi jù dōu dàshēng shuō.

blocks.text: Three more foods: fish, vegetables and soup

blocks.en: You already know chī (eat), hē (drink), and foods like mǐfàn, miànbāo, jīdàn, and ròu. Today we add fish, vegetables (or a dish), and soup. Fish and vegetables go with chī. Soup goes with hē in Chinese: you "drink" soup.
blocks.py: Nǐ yǐjīng zhīdào chī hé hē, hái yǒu mǐfàn, miànbāo, jīdàn hé ròu. Jīntiān wǒmen xué yú, cài hé tāng. Yú hé cài hé chī yìqǐ yòng. Tāng hé hē yìqǐ yòng: zài Zhōngwén lǐ, nǐ "hē" tāng.

blocks.note_en: Yú is 2nd tone: start mid and rise, like asking "huh?". The ü sound is lips round, saying "ee". Wǒ chī yú = I eat fish.
blocks.note_py: Yú shì 2nd tone: cóng zhōng xiàng shàng shēng. Ü shì zuǐchún yuán, fāyīn xiàng yī. Wǒ chī yú jiùshì I eat fish.

blocks.note_en: Cài is 4th tone, a quick drop. It means vegetables, and also a cooked dish. Wǒ chī cài = I eat vegetables.
blocks.note_py: Cài shì 4th tone, kuài sù xiàjiàng. Tā yìsi shì shūcài, yě shì yí dào cài. Wǒ chī cài jiùshì I eat vegetables.

blocks.note_en: Tāng is 1st tone: high and flat. Wǒ hē tāng = I drink soup.
blocks.note_py: Tāng shì 1st tone: gāo ér píng. Wǒ hē tāng jiùshì I drink soup.

blocks.en: Now we mix the new foods with words you already know: numbers, colors, family, pets, and your first words. Listen to each line, then say it out loud. Watch for old friends like jǐ, sān, wǔ, hēisè, lǜsè, dìdi, mèimei, and zhī.
blocks.py: Xiànzài bǎ xīn shíwù hé nǐ yǐjīng zhīdào de cí fàng zài yìqǐ: shùzì, yánsè, jiārén, chǒngwù hé zuì chū de cí. Měi jù xiān tīng zài shuō. Zhùyì jǐ, sān, wǔ, hēisè, lǜsè, dìdi, mèimei hé zhī zhèxiē lǎo péngyou.

blocks.en: I have one fish and three apples.
blocks.py: Wǒ yǒu yì tiáo yú hé sān gè píngguǒ.

blocks.en: My younger sister likes to eat green vegetables.
blocks.py: Wǒ de mèimei xǐhuan chī lǜsè de cài.

blocks.en: My son doesn't like soup. He drinks milk.
blocks.py: Wǒ de érzi bù xǐhuan hē tāng, tā hē niúnǎi.

blocks.en: How old is your friend? She is five.
blocks.py: Nǐ de péngyou jǐ suì? Tā wǔ suì.

blocks.title: Pattern: chī for food, hē for drinks and soup
blocks.body_en: Use chī with foods you chew: Wǒ chī yú, Wǒ chī cài. Use hē with drinks and soup: Wǒ hē tāng, Wǒ hē shuǐ. To count fish, use tiáo (a long thing): yì tiáo yú, liǎng tiáo yú. You can just notice it for now; zhī is for pets, tiáo is for fish.
blocks.body_py: Chī yòng zài yào jǔjué de shíwù: Wǒ chī yú, Wǒ chī cài. Hē yòng zài yǐnliào hé tāng: Wǒ hē tāng, Wǒ hē shuǐ. Shǔ yú yòng tiáo: yì tiáo yú, liǎng tiáo yú. Xiànzài xiān zhùyì jiù hǎo: zhī yòng yú chǒngwù, tiáo yòng yú yú.

pairs.en: I don't like to eat fish.

blocks.en: You can ask what someone eats with shénme, or ask a yes/no question with ma. Here are two short conversations that also bring back names, ages, and animals.
blocks.py: Nǐ kěyǐ yòng shénme wèn biérén chī shénme, yě kěyǐ yòng ma wèn shì bù shì. Xiàmiàn shì liǎng duàn duǎn duìhuà, yě huì yòng dào míngzi, niánlíng hé dòngwù.

blocks.note_en: Ma goes at the end for a yes/no question. Answer: Wǒ chī yú, or Wǒ bù chī yú.
blocks.note_py: Ma fàng zài jùwěi, wèn shì bù shì. Huídá: Wǒ chī yú, huò Wǒ bù chī yú.

blocks.title: Mini-chats
blocks.body_en: A: What's your name? B: My name is Mia. A: Mia, do you eat fish? B: Yes, I like to eat fish. / A: Do you have a dog? B: Yes, I have one dog. He is three. He eats meat and drinks water.
blocks.body_py: A: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi? B: Wǒ jiào Mia. A: Mia, nǐ chī yú ma? B: Chī, wǒ xǐhuan chī yú. / A: Nǐ yǒu gǒu ma? B: Wǒ yǒu yì zhī gǒu. Tā sān suì. Tā chī ròu, hē shuǐ.

pairs.en: What's your name? My name is Mia. Mia, do you eat fish? Yes, I like to eat fish.
pairs.py: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi? Wǒ jiào Mia. Mia, nǐ chī yú ma? Chī, wǒ xǐhuan chī yú.

pairs.en: Do you have a dog? I have one dog. He is three. He eats meat and drinks water.
pairs.py: Nǐ yǒu gǒu ma? Wǒ yǒu yì zhī gǒu. Tā sān suì. Tā chī ròu, hē shuǐ.

blocks.title: Say it at dinner
blocks.body_en: At your next meal, name what you see: yú, cài, tāng, mǐfàn, ròu, shuǐ. Count the pieces: yī, liǎng, sān. Using words with real things makes them stick.
blocks.body_py: Xiàcì chīfàn shí, shuō chū nǐ kàndào de: yú, cài, tāng, mǐfàn, ròu, shuǐ. Shǔ yi shǔ: yī, liǎng, sān. Bǎ cí hé zhēnshí de dōngxi yìqǐ yòng, zuì róngyì jì zhù.

sections.options_line: Choose from: chī · hē · xǐhuan · bù · jǐ · shénme · ma

items.prompt_en: Say what you eat, in a full pinyin sentence.
items.hint: Wǒ chī ___. (try yú, cài, or ròu)

items.prompt_en: Say you drink soup or water, in a full pinyin sentence.
Say your name, in a full pinyin sentence.

intro_callout.title: Record each clip right on this page
intro_callout.body_en: Listen to each model first, then record S1–S3. In S3, keep nǐ low and chī high and flat.
intro_callout.body_py: Xiān tīng, ránhòu lùyīn S1 dào S3. S3 lǐ nǐ shì 3rd tone, chī shì 1st tone, nǐ yào dī, chī yào gāo ér píng.

closing.en: Great work, Evan! Today, say Wǒ chī yú or Wǒ hē tāng once out loud. Tap Submit when your written answers and voice clips are ready. Jiāyóu!
closing.py: Zuò de hěn hǎo, Evan! Jīntiān dàshēng shuō yí biàn Wǒ chī yú huò Wǒ hē tāng. Nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo xiěxià de dá'àn hé yǔyīn le, jiù diǎn Submit. Jiāyóu!
